author: blu
body: Proves Icy Manipulator: "{1}, {T}: Tap target permanent." compiles to an ActivatedAbility carrying TapTarget. The AI activates it in the main phase against the opponent's biggest untapped creature, tapping it down. The Icy is summoning-sick here, proving noncreature artifacts ignore sickness for their {T} abilities. After activation the opponent's bear is tapped and the Icy is tapped and the mana was paid.
